seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Belen, New Mexico for 2026: 4 family events, 2 free, with dates, times and addresses checked on each host's site.
lede: Belen celebrates Christmas with a Main Street parade and outdoor market, a huge backyard light display beside the Rail Runner station and a New Mexico shepherds' play named for the town.
celebrates: The City of Belen Parks and Recreation Department hosts the Miracle on Main Parade and the Outdoor Christmas Market on December 12, with the market on Becker Avenue hosted by the Belen Art League. Across from the Rail Runner station, a local family lights up De Soto Avenue every night from November 28 to January 3 and welcomes Santa on December 19. Los Pastores de Belen perform La Gran Pastorela at Our Lady of Belen on December 6, and Socorro adds luminarias and a light parade on December 5.
lastyear: In 2025 the Miracle on Main Street Parade and Outdoor Christmas Market took place on Saturday, December 13, according to the community calendar listing from the city's event. The city's own Facebook page also invited families to Light Up the Season in Belen with live music, crafts and activities for all ages to kick off the holidays. The Christmas Display of Lights on De Soto Avenue has returned for a third year in 2026.
facts: Los Pastores de Belen say they have presented a version of the shepherds' play since 1973, using a script from the village of Las Nutrias. The play is named for Belen, the town of the Christ Child's birth, and the group counts about 70 documented versions of the shepherds' play in New Mexico. The De Soto Avenue display has over 100,000 LED and pixel lights, over 35 inflatables and a 20 foot snowman.
trains: The Belen Harvey House Museum is a restored Fred Harvey dining house beside the rail line, and freight trains pass close by. The New Mexico Rail Runner Express stops in Belen, and the De Soto Avenue Christmas Display of Lights is across from the Rail Runner station. Rio Metro lists no Rail Runner service on Christmas Day, December 25, 2026, and a Fall and Winter schedule in effect since November 1.

faq: When is the Belen Christmas parade in 2026?

The Miracle on Main Parade begins at 6 pm on Saturday, December 12, 2026. The city says it runs from Camino del Llano to Aragon, and the Outdoor Christmas Market runs from 10 am to 6 pm on Becker Avenue the same day.
Where can kids see Christmas lights in Belen?

At 202A De Soto Avenue, across from the Rail Runner station, every night from dusk until midnight from November 28, 2026, to January 3, 2027, weather permitting. Santa and Mrs. Claus visit on December 19 from 5 to 7 pm.
Is there a Christmas play in Belen?
Yes. Los Pastores de Belen perform La Gran Pastorela on December 6, 2026, at 4 pm at Our Lady of Belen, 101-A North 10th Street. The group's page does not print a ticket price.
Is there a train to ride in Belen at Christmas?
The Rail Runner stops in Belen, and the Harvey House Museum sits beside the rail line. The sources checked did not list a 2026 Santa train, so check the Rio Metro schedule before you plan a ride.
